Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in comparing the dates. It stated that "Kingdom of Rock was released earlier than Was I the Wave? by about 4 years and 6 months." This is incorrect. "Was I The Wave?" was released on April 26, 2011, and "Kingdom Of Rock" was released on November 6, 2015. 2011 is earlier than 2015. Therefore, "Was I The Wave?" came out earlier, not "Kingdom Of Rock". The Planner incorrectly reversed the chronological order in its conclusion despite having the correct dates from the previous step.
